platform.name: JOMETRY Modular Wall Architectural Systems
platform.tagline: The Wall Surface construction technology that Adapts evolving Needs
platform.description: Demountable precision dry wall cladding platform, engineered for tool-less access for the life of the building. Adapting utilisation of wall surface for acoustic control, air bio-filtration, exterior rainscreens, illuminated elevations and MEP service raceways.
platform.mountingMethodology: Patented WallClick Node (Architectural Die-Cast Zinc & SS304)
platform.standoffRange: 50 mm to 220 mm adjustable depth from substrate (Custom offsets up to 350 mm for deep MEP)
platform.vibrationDampening: EPDM elastomeric isolation rings on all nodes
platform.cycleDurability: Rated >500 toolless demount cycles without mechanical play
platform.fireClassification: Class 1 / Class A flame spread rated (ASTM E84 / EN 13501, BS 476 Part 6 & 7 compliant)
platform.acousticIsolation: STC 48–54 with cavity infill and isolation gaskets (ISO 10140 / ASTM E90)

typologies.name: Acoustic Control
typologies.tagline: Adjustable cavity depth tunes Helmholtz absorption (NRC 0.80–0.95) to room geometry
typologies.description: Most acoustic panels are a material problem. Ours is a geometry problem. A slotted face over an air cavity acts as a Helmholtz resonant absorber. The depth of that cavity determines which frequencies are absorbed — deeper cavity, lower bass resonance.

operationalComparison.title: The same job, two ways: Adding a data outlet or repairing an internal line in an existing wall elevation

conventional.name: Conventional Drywall Partition
steps: 1. Isolate area & erect plastic dust containment tent
2. Cut open board with power drywall saw
3. Pull new cabling / chase electrical fault
4. Patch backing board, tape joints, skim wet plaster
5. Wait 24–48 hours curing and drying time
6. Sand smooth — generating fine airborne silica dust
7. Repaint entire wall elevation for color match
8. Clean down and reinstate occupied space
conventional.metrics: 3 to 5 Days Disruption · Room Out of Service · Heavy Dust & Fumes

jometry.name: WallClick Node Demountable Platform
steps: 1. Tool-less unclip of targeted Panel Surface
2. Route new cabling through segregated raceway / Change of Function
3. Clip cassette firmly back onto concealed node
jometry.metrics: Under 3 Minutes · Zero Dust · Zero Trades · Zero Downtime
